en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large ceremonial procession crossing an ornate bridge. Mounted soldiers ride in formation, followed by uniformed groups, while dense crowds line both sides of the street and bridge. The bridge entrance is flanked by tall stone pylons topped with seated allegorical statues and lion sculptures at their bases. Period clothing (top hats, bowler hats, long dresses) suggests an early 20th‑century event. Some people hold placards, and there are lampposts and substantial stone embankments in the background.
